topic: For finite ordered SCMs with explicitly listed finite alphabets, unrestricted complete-predecessor functions, and arbitrary shared exogenous variation, prove that the equality partition of h factual/intervention-world complete prefixes is an exact continuation state. Derive representative transitions deciding one explicit unnested conjunction in Bell(h) * 3^((h-1)/3) * poly(input) time and an explicit rational combination of r conjunctions in Bell(h) * 2^r * (r+1)^(h-1) * poly(input) time, with alphabet size absent from the exponential. Reconstruct sparse response rows plus defaults, attain sharp observational cell-sum endpoints with one exogenous atom per positive-mass cell, and preserve joint term dependence. Prove a scoped separation on binary S<T<X1<...<Xn<Y: factual zero, A=do(S=1), B=do(S=1,T=1), and query T_A=0, all X_i,A=0, Y_B=1 leave 2^n accepting numeric B histories after every pin but one partition state per layer. Charge dense input reading and explicit unnesting; exclude sparse prescribed graphs, independence restrictions, cycles, and claims about all reduced MDDs. Credit Halpern's certificate/hardness and Rossetto--Antonucci's cell-sum construction. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Informal proofs establish exact partition continuation, complete representative transitions, both transition bounds, joint truth flags, sparse traceback, false-bit handling, and cellwise attainment. Existing checks passed 119,100 local transitions, 18,486 joint cell problems, 1,200 mixed-alphabet cases, and 192 NDE cases. A fresh independent pass added 1,414 same-partition suffix-support and 1,369 partition-plus-flags truth-support comparisons, including all 32,768 binary four-variable response systems. Actual pinned copid query classes and builds produced three normalized contexts and 2^n accepting pre-Y prefixes for n=1 through 4. Contradictory/repeated terms, empty conjunctions, singleton and exhausted alphabets, cross-block constants, false-bit asymmetry, sparse/dense inputs, structural versus sample zeros, and the prescribed-sparse-graph counterexample were checked. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: No core theorem implication remains unresolved; the principal risk is an unlocated equality-abstraction specialization with the same causal h-context theorem, followed by production implementation and formal verification. EARLY KILL TEST: Compare complete numeric suffix supports for histories sharing a partition and terminal truth supports for histories sharing partition plus flags across mixed alphabets and query constants; any mismatch kills the quotient, and a literal prior theorem with these bounds forces a novelty pivot. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/scm_order_world_partition_compiler.md.

open_problems.open_problem: Can the equality partition of h complete factual/intervention-world prefixes be proved to be an exact local continuation state for order-only finite SCMs, yielding query compilation and sharp observational bounds with exponential dependence on h but not on alphabet cardinalities?

source_refs.claim: Their order-only response-signature LP uses a global evaluation quotient whose size retains an alphabet-product term, and their conclusion explicitly calls for finer quotient-space reductions.
source_refs.author: Eric Rossetto and Alessandro Antonucci

source_refs.claim: For fully specified SCMs, certain complete multi-world queries can reuse a compilation of the original SCM independently of the number of worlds; unknown mechanisms and sharp partial-ID optimization are not covered.
source_refs.author: Benjie Wang

open_problems.why_unsolved: Rossetto--Antonucci quotient response signatures only after evaluating observational cells and the query, so constructing their lifted classes retains alphabet-product dependence; Wang's compilation presupposes a fully specified SCM and exogenous law. Targeted searches for equality-partition, Bell-number, prefix-continuation, and finite-SCM response-function compilers found no theorem establishing that a local equality type is a right congruence for every later complete-predecessor function, nor a sharp cell-sum construction from such a quotient.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: An exact continuation-equivalence characterization with complete representative transitions, explicit h-parameterized runtime bounds whose exponential factor is alphabet-independent, and a constructive map from every feasible observational-cell mass vector to an attaining sparse SCM.

writing_exemplar.why: It frames arbitrary counterfactual bounds from a causal order, response signatures, lifted equivalence classes, tight witnesses, and the need for a finer quotient.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Counterfactual bounds usually require a graph -> a query-implied order permits an exact response-signature LP -> the remaining alphabet-sized quotient motivates a local continuation abstraction

method_exemplars.technique: Reuse a compilation of a fully specified SCM for multi-world abduction-action-prediction, proving that the selected complete-world query class does not increase compilation complexity with the world count.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It is the nearest world-count-insensitive compilation result, while the desired resolution must replace known functions by continuation classes over all admissible functions.

method_exemplars.technique: Specify a compilation language through its supported queries and transformations, then compare representations through succinctness-preserving translations and separations.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The continuation quotient is a causal knowledge-compilation language whose exactness and succinctness must both be established.

method_exemplars.technique: Apply the directional delta method to an optimization-value functional and use derivative-aware resampling where the ordinary bootstrap is inconsistent.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Sharp LP endpoints as functions of empirical cell probabilities are piecewise linear and generally only directionally differentiable.

open_problems.open_problem: Is Bell(h) worst-case optimal for every online exact continuation quotient that evaluates sharp h-world counterfactual-bound queries over unrestricted ordered finite SCMs, or can the equality-partition state be uniformly coarsened?

source_refs.claim: The authors identify finer quotient-space reductions as future work after introducing an evaluation-based quotient of response signatures.
source_refs.author: Eric Rossetto and Alessandro Antonucci

source_refs.claim: The knowledge-compilation map separates succinctness from polynomial-time supported queries and supplies a framework for lower-bound comparisons among compiled representations.
source_refs.author: Adnan Darwiche and Pierre Marquis

source_refs.claim: Satisfiability for causal formulas over an input finite signature is NP-complete, but this does not determine parameterized state complexity for a fixed number of parallel worlds.
source_refs.author: Joseph Y. Halpern

open_problems.why_unsolved: A separation from the number of numeric histories does not establish that every set partition is a distinct residual query state. A causal Myhill--Nerode lower bound would require, for each pair of partitions, a suffix of structural rows and terminal literals that accepts one and rejects the other while respecting a common ordered SCM. Existing causal-complexity results give broad NP or PSPACE classifications, and compilation work gives general representation comparisons, but the scan found no Bell-number lower bound for this continuation language.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A causal Myhill--Nerode characterization exhibiting Bell(h) pairwise distinguishable residuals, or an explicit strictly smaller complete quotient, together with a scoped comparison to ordered MDD or OBDD representations for sharp counterfactual-bound evaluation.

writing_exemplar.why: Its separation of succinctness from supported operations is the appropriate motivation arc for a state-minimality result.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Compilation makes repeated hard queries reusable -> target languages trade succinctness against tractable operations -> locate the minimal causal continuation quotient on that map

method_exemplars.technique: Use polynomial translations and succinctness separations to compare canonical compiled representations under fixed query operations.
method_exemplars.why_closest: A Bell(h) lower bound is a succinctness statement for a causal compilation target.

method_exemplars.technique: Encode propositional witnesses into recursive causal models while controlling the finite signature and the variables mentioned by the formula.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Pairwise residual distinguishability similarly requires small explicit causal witnesses rather than an informal state count.

open_problems.open_problem: Can equality-pattern continuation compilation produce exact sharp counterfactual bounds from an arbitrary finite collection of observational and interventional tables without enumerating the full response signature or placing all table cells in the exponential part?

source_refs.claim: The paper handles arbitrary collections of observational and experimental distributions through canonical-SCM polynomial programs but states that solving them is generally computationally expensive.
source_refs.author: Junzhe Zhang, Jin Tian, and Elias Bareinboim

source_refs.claim: Multiple observational, randomized, and selection-biased datasets are fused through graphical transformations and causal EM to approximate partially identified counterfactual bounds.
source_refs.author: Marco Zaffalon, Alessandro Antonucci, Rafael Cabanas, and David Huber

source_refs.claim: The order-only sharp LP is formulated against one empirical observational marginal and partitions response signatures using that marginal's cell evaluations and the query evaluation.
source_refs.author: Eric Rossetto and Alessandro Antonucci

open_problems.why_unsolved: For one observational law, an attaining construction can assign mass separately to each positive factual cell. With several regimes, the same latent response row contributes to constraints in multiple tables, so private per-cell atoms and a truth vector indexed by one table no longer suffice. Existing arbitrary-data results retain canonical response types and polynomial programs or use approximate EM; the scan found no local partition-state compiler preserving the necessary cross-regime coupling.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A joint continuation-state characterization for all supplied regimes, an exact finite LP or equivalent oracle algorithm with a constructive common-SCM attainment proof, and a runtime bound separating world and regime parameters from dense input reading.

writing_exemplar.why: It frames the destination around arbitrary observational and experimental inputs, canonical completeness, sharpness, and the resulting computational barrier.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Counterfactual information comes from heterogeneous observational and experimental sources -> canonical SCMs make the sharp region explicit -> response-type polynomial programs are expensive and invite a query-specific quotient

method_exemplars.technique: Lift the sharp LP using response-signature truth classes and construct an SCM attaining every optimum under a query-implied order.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The desired result generalizes this quotient-and-attainment argument from one factual table to a coupled family of regimes.

method_exemplars.technique: Compile a fixed structural topology into a symbolic arithmetic circuit and reuse it across changing exogenous parameters and repeated queries.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Multi-table constraints repeatedly evaluate the same response-row semantics, which is the workload symbolic reuse addresses.

method_exemplars.technique: Obtain limit laws and locally valid resampling for optimization values that are only directionally differentiable.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The multi-source sharp endpoints are nonsmooth functions of several estimated multinomial laws.

open_problems.open_problem: Can nested and general Boolean counterfactual formulas be compiled directly over finite ordered SCMs without first expanding them into exponentially many unnested conjunctions, while retaining joint cross-world dependence?

source_refs.claim: Nested counterfactuals are handled by syntactic unnesting into sums of standard counterfactual conjunctions before constructing the LP.
source_refs.author: Eric Rossetto and Alessandro Antonucci

source_refs.claim: A fully expressive probabilistic language for arbitrary counterfactual queries has complete finitary axioms, while satisfiability and validity are placed in PSPACE.
source_refs.author: Duligur Ibeling and Thomas Icard

source_refs.claim: ID* and IDC* provide complete graphical identification procedures for counterfactual and conditional-counterfactual queries using parallel-world graphs and c-component factorization.
source_refs.author: Ilya Shpitser and Judea Pearl

open_problems.why_unsolved: Unnesting duplicates branch-specific worlds and may create a 2^r family of conjunctions. A direct evaluator must retain intervention bindings and substitution dependencies, so equality of current numeric prefixes alone is not evidently a continuation congruence. The logical literature treats unrestricted expressivity at PSPACE granularity, while graphical work treats identifiability; the scan found no parameterized direct compiler for order-only partial identification with explicit dependence on formula size, live-world count, and nesting depth.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A syntax-directed automaton or circuit with a proved sufficient continuation state, exact sharp-bound semantics preserving joint dependence, and matching upper or lower runtime bounds in formula size, nesting depth, and the number of simultaneously live worlds.

writing_exemplar.why: It presents counterfactual formula expressivity as a hierarchy and makes the complexity of the full language the motivating endpoint.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Association, intervention, and counterfactual languages increase in expressive power -> the full language has complete semantics and axioms -> bounded live-world structure may support a sharper direct compiler

method_exemplars.technique: Recursively unnest counterfactuals and evaluate each resulting conjunction against canonical response signatures before quotienting by truth evaluations.
method_exemplars.why_closest: This is the baseline transformation a direct compiler must simulate without materializing all branches.

method_exemplars.technique: Merge consistent nodes in parallel-world graphs and recursively factor counterfactual queries into c-components, returning graphical failure certificates when identification fails.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Parallel-world merging is structurally analogous to quotienting cross-world identities before symbolic evaluation.

method_exemplars.technique: Construct valid inference for directionally differentiable maps using an estimated directional derivative rather than the ordinary bootstrap.
method_exemplars.why_closest: A direct exact compiler still produces piecewise-linear sharp endpoints from sampled cell probabilities.

open_problems.open_problem: For a prescribed sparse acyclic graph with arbitrary shared exogenous variation, what finite augmentation of prefix equality partitions is sufficient for exact counterfactual-bound continuation, and is evaluation fixed-parameter tractable in world count and graph width?

source_refs.claim: Order-only bounds deliberately abstain from graphical conditional independences; graph-based methods can be tighter, while adding independence constraints can greatly enlarge the lifted quotient.
source_refs.author: Eric Rossetto and Alessandro Antonucci

source_refs.claim: For fully specified SCMs, N-world counterfactual inference is controlled constructively by treewidth and causal treewidth, with twin-network width at most twice the original width plus one.
source_refs.author: Yunqiu Han, Yizuo Chen, and Adnan Darwiche
source_refs.venue: International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence

source_refs.claim: Exact counterfactual-bound computation through credal networks is NP-hard even on polytrees, motivating restricted subclasses and approximation.
source_refs.author: Marco Zaffalon, Alessandro Antonucci, Rafael Cabanas, David Huber, and Dario Azzimonti

open_problems.why_unsolved: The complete-predecessor model is symmetric in predecessor values, allowing equality patterns to erase numeric labels. A sparse graph exposes selected parent projections, so histories with the same global equality partition can have different legal continuations. Han--Chen--Darwiche control multi-world inference only after mechanisms are fixed, while Zaffalon et al. show that partial specification remains hard even on polytrees; no located work combines a response-function quotient with a graph-separator state.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A necessary-and-sufficient boundary-state characterization, such as a partition augmented by separator parent contexts, with a sharp-bound algorithm running in f(h,w)poly(input), or a matching hardness result for a named sparse graph class.

writing_exemplar.why: It foregrounds exact counterfactual bounds, graph structure, and the polytree hardness barrier that this sparse-graph direction must confront.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Partially specified SCMs require bounds -> credal-network structure enables exact algorithms on a subclass -> hardness even on polytrees demands a sharper world-count and width parameterization

method_exemplars.technique: Construct N-world networks and bound their treewidth and causal treewidth using jointrees and thinned jointrees that exploit functional dependencies.
method_exemplars.why_closest: A separator-aware continuation quotient should interface with these graph-width decompositions while additionally quantifying over unknown response functions.

method_exemplars.technique: Canonicalize discrete SCMs into polynomial programs and use dual relaxation with spatial branch-and-bound to obtain certified outer ranges and epsilon-sharpness.
method_exemplars.why_closest: It supplies the general sharp-bound fallback against which a fixed-parameter sparse-graph quotient can be proved exact and computationally stronger.

method_exemplars.technique: Derive limit laws and valid resampling for directionally differentiable optimization-value maps.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Empirical graph-aware sharp endpoints are nonregular when active response types or separator constraints change.

open_problems.open_problem: Can an exact compact continuation representation be obtained for finite ordered SCMs when exogenous shocks must factor by node or latent district rather than being an arbitrary shared exogenous variable?

source_refs.claim: The order-only LP uses one shared exogenous variable, and its examples show that independence constraints can expand the lifted optimization space from tens to tens of thousands of classes.
source_refs.author: Eric Rossetto and Alessandro Antonucci

source_refs.claim: For arbitrary discrete DAGs and observational or experimental inputs, canonical SCMs translate sharp counterfactual bounds into generally expensive polynomial programs.
source_refs.author: Junzhe Zhang, Jin Tian, and Elias Bareinboim

source_refs.claim: A credal-network mapping gives exact bounds for a subclass of partially specified discrete SCMs and approximate causal-EM bounds more generally.
source_refs.author: Marco Zaffalon, Alessandro Antonucci, Rafael Cabanas, David Huber, and Dario Azzimonti

open_problems.why_unsolved: The shared-exogenous-variable attainment proof may allocate one atom independently to each positive observational cell. Nodewise or districtwise independence imposes product or rank constraints tying masses across cells, so both the cellwise witness and linear-LP geometry fail at their first step. Canonical polynomial programming and credal-network methods encode these constraints, but the scan found no equality-type or orbit quotient controlling their size independently of endogenous alphabet cardinalities.
open_problems.what_a_resolution_would_look_like: A factor-aware continuation state and exact polynomial or convex formulation with constructive sharpness and parameterized complexity guarantees, or a precise impossibility boundary separating Markovian and semi-Markovian subclasses.

writing_exemplar.why: It clearly motivates the tension among exact bounds, exogenous factorization, credal representations, and computational hardness.
writing_exemplar.motivation_arc: Unknown exogenous laws make counterfactuals partially identified -> factorized SCM structure maps to credal inference -> exactness remains hard and calls for a symmetry-aware factor representation

method_exemplars.technique: Canonicalize every latent district into finite response types and translate observational, experimental, and query constraints into a sharp polynomial program.
method_exemplars.why_closest: The destination differs from the shared-exogenous LP exactly through the multiplicative compatibility constraints exposed by this construction.

method_exemplars.technique: Compile repeated counterfactual-bound instances into a symbolic arithmetic circuit whose exogenous parameters can change without recompilation.
method_exemplars.why_closest: A compact factor-aware quotient should compile repeated polynomial or credal queries rather than enumerate all response types.

method_exemplars.technique: Use directional derivatives and derivative-consistent resampling for nonsmooth plug-in functionals.
method_exemplars.why_closest: Sharp endpoints of the factor-constrained program are nonsmooth functions of estimated cell probabilities.

literature_map:
Halpern (2000, JAIR, doi:10.1613/jair.648) axiomatizes recursive finite causal models and proves input-signature satisfiability NP-complete, supplying the broad certificate/hardness anchor but no h-world parameterization.
Balke--Pearl (1994, UAI/AAAI) establish response-function linear programming for counterfactual probabilities; Tian--Pearl (2000, Annals of Mathematics and Artificial Intelligence, doi:10.1023/A:1018912507879) sharpen probabilities-of-causation bounds and attainment from observational plus experimental data.
Shpitser--Pearl (2008, JMLR, arXiv:1206.5294) give complete ID*/IDC* procedures on parallel-world graphs, addressing graph-native identifiability rather than order-only optimization over all mechanisms.
Ibeling--Icard (2020, AAAI, arXiv:2001.02889) axiomatize a fully expressive probabilistic counterfactual language and give PSPACE decision upper bounds, leaving room for fixed-world and bounded-formula parameterizations.
Zhang--Tian--Bareinboim (2022, ICML, arXiv:2110.05690) canonicalize arbitrary discrete-DAG SCMs and obtain sharp polynomial programs for arbitrary observational and experimental inputs, but emphasize their general computational expense.
Duarte--Finkelstein--Knox--Mummolo--Shpitser (2024, JASA, arXiv:2109.13471, doi:10.1080/01621459.2023.2216909) automate sharp discrete causal bounds using polynomial optimization with certified outer ranges and epsilon-sharpness.
Zaffalon--Antonucci--Cabanas--Huber--Azzimonti (2024, IJAR, arXiv:2307.08304) map partially specified SCMs to credal networks, prove NP-hardness even on polytrees, and use causal-EM inner approximations.
Han--Chen--Darwiche (2023, IJCAI, arXiv:2211.13447) bound N-world treewidth and causal treewidth for fully specified SCMs; this controls graph inference after mechanisms are known, not response-function uncertainty.
Wang (2023, Oxford thesis, doi:10.5287/ora-2anj4dbdx) identifies a complete-world query class evaluable on a compilation of the original fully specified SCM independently of world count; Wang--Kwiatkowska (2023, AISTATS PMLR 206) give compositional causal inference on tractable circuits.
Huber--Chen--Antonucci--Darwiche--Zaffalon (2023, TPM@UAI, arXiv:2310.03352) reuse symbolic arithmetic-circuit compilation for repeated approximate counterfactual-bound computations but do not quotient unknown mechanisms by prefix continuation.
Rossetto--Antonucci (2026, arXiv:2608.24427) is the closest anchor: it gives order-only arbitrary and nested-query LPs, an evaluation-based lifted quotient, and constructive sharp SCMs; the quotient retains alphabet-product size and the conclusion calls for finer reductions.
Darwiche--Marquis (2002, JAIR, doi:10.1613/jair.989) supplies the succinctness-versus-supported-queries discipline for compilation lower bounds; Fang--Santos (2019, ReStud, arXiv:1404.3763) and Chernozhukov--Lee--Rosen (2013, Econometrica, arXiv:0907.3503) supply inference machinery for nonsmooth or LP-bound endpoints.
